text:
The UK Commission for Employment and Skills (UKCES) is running a programme of competitions that target specific workforce development problems. Engaging a wide range of employers is an important part of any potential solution. This document provides advice and guidance to Futures Programme applicants on how to successfully do so.

This is one of six separate UKCES Futures Programme guidance documents. The other five are:

Potential for impact

Innovation

Types of project

Private and public contributions

Testing and shared learning

You can download all the content in a single UK Future Programme guidance document.

There is an additional guide which provides information on the assessment criteria.

For more information please visit the UK Futures Programme introduction page.
